summary: OAuth login: read-only default scopes (listings_r shops_r transactions_r), --all-scopes/--scopes/ETSY_SCOPES precedence in one builder, registered-redirect two-step PKCE (print authorize URL, then --callback-url), shared authorize-URL scope param, callback error text sanitized.
reason: The generated auth login used a local callback server with a fixed scope set. Etsy apps register an https redirect, and least privilege requires read-only by default with email_r and write scopes behind --all-scopes. etsyRequestedScopes and etsySetScopeParam are the single places scopes are assembled; etsy_auth.go holds the two-step flow, pending PKCE state and etsySanitizeCallbackText.
